summary: A Yes vote amends the Los Angeles County Charter to change the structure, independence, appointments, and duties of the County Ethics Commission, Office of Ethics Compliance, and Ethics Compliance Officer, and to continue the County's community investment and alternatives-to-incarceration commitment.

safety.text: A Yes vote continues the county’s commitment to community investment and alternatives to incarceration in the county charter.
